_comment: Loud, documented staleness waivers for the provenance gate (evals/provenance.py). Every entry needs a non-empty reason; remove an entry the moment the artifact is regenerated. Current entries: the 2026-08-10 hta.org domain move, the Elk Grove (e-tran) sixth-agency addition, and the Santa Cruz METRO (SCMTD) seventh-agency addition, all three pending the same next promoted eval run.

acknowledged.reason: Three causes, all pending the same regeneration. (1) 2026-08-10: hta-fares source domain moved (humboldttransit.org now 404s; site relocated to hta.org). The refetch rebound corpus_version 0938fff0539a to 35ec70d6359d; the refresh report confirmed no policy-text change, only the source URL and fetch metadata. (2) 2026-08-12: Elk Grove Transit Services (e-tran) added as the sixth agency (etran-fares, etran-senior-pass), rebinding corpus_version to e15051d6f7a1. (3) 2026-08-12: Santa Cruz METRO (SCMTD) added as the seventh agency (scmtd-fares-passes, scmtd-accessibility, scmtd-tap2cruz). Merging (2) and (3) rebound corpus_version once more, to feb21f02c510 (120 chunks), which is what HEAD now ships. Unlike (1), both (2) and (3) are new policy text: the committed scores were computed against a corpus containing neither agency. They remain valid for the cases they cover and say nothing at all about the new E-tran or SCMTD cases, none of which has ever been scored live. Regenerate all three artifacts at the next promoted live eval run and remove these entries.
